summary: Elmet Group Co. filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, furnishing an updated corporate presentation under Item 7.01 and disclosing under Item 8.01 that Executive Vice President and General Counsel Christian T. Chandler, who has served since the Company's founding, will retire effective December 31, 2026, and remain an advisor. The departure is planned, not forced or abrupt, and no successor, separation terms, or board recommendation are stated. The presentation is furnished, not filed. Watch for any subsequent Form 8-K announcing a named replacement or interim General Counsel.
